topic: Why one page per service beats one page listing everything

script.hook: One page for everything is killing your rankings.
beats: Google ranks pages, not websites. One service per page wins every time.
A plumber in Hesperia needs a Hesperia plumbing page, not a general services list.
Split your services into separate pages and watch local search traffic climb.
